sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the unconditional top-level sh:in restriction on nltl:shipCategory. It currently makes every ship outside categories A/B fail before the applicability alternative can pass, causing accidental pass/fail logic. Retain the required category cardinality, but enforce categories A/B only inside the applicable branch; keep the existing non-applicable SPARQL branch, per-loading-condition alternatives, canonical UNITLESS unit, expected-result-scaled tolerance, loading-condition path, and evidence relationship unchanged.
